FuchsiaCity_WardensHouse_Text_AhHowheeHo.en: Ah howhee ho hoo!\nEef ee hafahi ho!
FuchsiaCity_WardensHouse_Text_AhHowheeHo.fr: Ah howhee ho hoo !\nEef ee hafahi ho !

FuchsiaCity_WardensHouse_Text_EmptyCase.en: The display case is open... but\nthe WARDEN is only chuckling.\pWARDEN: Hif fuff hee hee hee!\nHo hoo hif feef!
FuchsiaCity_WardensHouse_Text_EmptyCase.fr: La vitrine est ouverte… mais le\nGARDIEN ne fait que ricaner.\pGARDIEN : Hif fuff hee hee hee !\nHo hoo hif feef !

FuchsiaCity_WardensHouse_Text_ExplainStr.en:
WARDEN: Inside HM04 you'll find
STRENGTH.\pIt lets POKéMON move boulders when
you're outside of battle.\pOh yes, did you find the SECRET
HOUSE in the SAFARI ZONE?
FuchsiaCity_WardensHouse_Text_ExplainStr.fr: GARDIEN : la CS04 contient FORCE !\pTes POKéMON pourront déplacer des\nrochers.\pAu fait, as-tu trouvé la CABANE\nSECRÈTE dans le PARC SAFARI ?

FuchsiaCity_WardensHouse_Text_GaveGoldTe.en: {PLAYER} gave the GOLD TEETH\nto the WARDEN.
FuchsiaCity_WardensHouse_Text_GaveGoldTe.fr: {PLAYER} a donné les DENTS EN OR\nau GARDIEN.

FuchsiaCity_WardensHouse_Text_Grunt1Defe.en: Argh! The boss will hear of this!
FuchsiaCity_WardensHouse_Text_Grunt1Defe.fr: Argh ! Le boss en entendra parler !

FuchsiaCity_WardensHouse_Text_Grunt2Defe.en: No way! We had the stone!

FuchsiaCity_WardensHouse_Text_HeOhayHeHa.en: Ha?\nHe ohay heh ha hoo ee haheh!
FuchsiaCity_WardensHouse_Text_HeOhayHeHa.fr: Ha ? Hai fou heh ha hoo ih haheh !

FuchsiaCity_WardensHouse_Text_HifFuffHef.en: WARDEN: Hif fuff hefifoo!\pHa lof ha feef ee hafahi ho.\nHeff hee fwee!
FuchsiaCity_WardensHouse_Text_HifFuffHef.fr: GARDIEN : Hif fuff hefifou !\pHa fof ha fif eu hafahi ho. Heff hi\nfwi !

FuchsiaCity_WardensHouse_Text_MonPhotosF.en: POKéMON photos and fossils are on\ndisplay.

FuchsiaCity_WardensHouse_Text_RaidAfter.en: Their leader already took the case\nand bolted out the back.\pThe two thugs follow, laughing.\nThey cannot be caught now.
FuchsiaCity_WardensHouse_Text_RaidAfter.fr: Leur chef a déjà pris la vitrine et\ns'est enfui par l'arrière.\pLes deux brutes le suivent en\nriant. On ne peut plus les\lrattraper.

FuchsiaCity_WardensHouse_Text_RaidIntro.en: Back off, kid! The AMETHIOLITE is\nONYBRIS property now!
FuchsiaCity_WardensHouse_Text_RaidIntro.fr: Recule ! L'AMETHIOLITE est\nla propriété d'ONYBRIS maintenant !

FuchsiaCity_WardensHouse_Text_RealStone.en:
WARDEN: Now I can speak! Thank
you, child. You beat those thugs!\pThe thieves took a replica, a
cheap amethyst I put on display.\pThe real AMETHIOLITE is yours now.
Guard it better than I did.\pAnd go east when the road reopens.
The old FISHER on the ROUTE 12\lPIER knows where the AURA began.
FuchsiaCity_WardensHouse_Text_RealStone.fr:
GARDIEN : Maintenant je peux
parler ! Merci. Tu as battu ces\lbrutes !\pLes voleurs ont pris une réplique,
une améthyste bon marché que\lj'exposais.\pLa vraie AMETHIOLITE est à toi
maintenant. Garde-la mieux que moi.\pEt va à l'est quand la route
rouvrira. Le vieux PÊCHEUR de la\pJETÉE de la ROUTE 12 sait où l'AURA
a commencé.

FuchsiaCity_WardensHouse_Text_ThanksLass.en:
WARDEN: Thank you, lassie!
You're a real lifesaver!\pNo one could understand a word
that I said, not a one!\pI was too ashamed to show my face
around the OFFICE, even.\pLet me give you something for your
trouble.
FuchsiaCity_WardensHouse_Text_ThanksLass.fr:
GARDIEN : Merci !
Tu me sauves la mise !\pPersonne ne comprenait un mot de ce
que je disais, pas un !\pJ'avais trop honte pour montrer mon
visage même au BUREAU.\pLaisse-moi te donner quelque chose
pour ta peine.

FuchsiaCity_WardensHouse_Text_ThanksSonG.en:
WARDEN: Thanks, son!
You're a real lifesaver!\pNo one could understand a word
that I said, not a one!\pI was too ashamed to show my face
around the OFFICE, even.\pLet me give you something for your

FuchsiaCity_WardensHouse_Text_ThanksSonG.fr:
GARDIEN : Merci, fiston !
Tu me sauves la mise !\pPersonne ne comprenait un mot de ce
que je disais, pas un !\pJ'avais trop honte pour montrer mon
visage même au BUREAU.\pLaisse-moi te donner quelque chose
pour ta peine.

FuchsiaCity_WardensHouse_Text_WardenPopp.en: The WARDEN popped in his teeth!
